title: Catalog filters
responsibility: Opens catalog filters and sorting from one compact icon.

inputs.name: FilterDialog.active
inputs.description: Number of nondefault filter and sort choices. Highlights the icon; excludes local search.

inputs.name: FilterDialog.onreset
inputs.description: Restores default filter and sort choices while preserving the local search query.

inputs.name: FilterDialog.children
inputs.description: The catalog’s existing filter controls, rendered inside the dialog.

outputs.name: FilterDialog
outputs.description: One icon opens a Filters modal. Done, Escape and backdrop close it and restore focus to the icon. Reset invokes the supplied callback.
